description: The plot illustrates the loss over the number of iterations for different configurations of SepLLM, a method for accelerating large language models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 95,000 to 125,000 iterations, with tick labels at intervals of 5,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.0 to 2.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four lines: a solid pink line representing SepLLM with n=64 and larger lr, a solid blue line representing SepLLM with n=128, a solid orange line representing SepLLM with n=64, and a dashed red line representing Vanilla before post-training. The pink line starts at a loss of approximately 2.8 and decreases to around 2.2 by the end of the iterations. The blue line starts at a loss of approximately 2.7 and decreases to around 2.2 by the end of the iterations. The orange line starts at a loss of approximately 2.6 and decreases to around 2.2 by the end of the iterations. The dashed red line remains constant at a loss of approximately 2.2 throughout the iterations.
